pages.text: This feature keeps the overworld day length $(bold)constant$() while changing how much of it is daylight, depending on the season.$(br2)It requires BetterDays to drive the time speed; this mod overrides the per-tick progression based on the current season and time of day.

pages.title: Defaults
pages.text: $(li)1 MC day = $(thing)mcDayLengthMinutes$() real minutes (default 60, vanilla is 20).$(li)Daytime share: spring 50%, summer 65%, autumn 50%, winter 35%.$(br2)So in winter you get about 21 minutes of daylight per real hour; in summer about 39 minutes.

pages.title: Changing it
pages.text: All values are configurable in $(thing)config/seedseasons-common.toml$():$(li)mcDayLengthMinutes - the whole day length$(li)springDayPercent / summerDayPercent / autumnDayPercent / winterDayPercent - the daylight share per season$(br2)Night automatically gets the remaining percentage.

pages.title: Limits & Side Effects
pages.text: $(li)Only the $(bold)Overworld$() is affected; the Nether and the End are untouched.$(li)Turning $(thing)enableSeasonalDayNight$() off restores BetterDays' defaults, and its own sleep acceleration keeps working.$(li)Only the $(bold)time speed$() changes - not the sky light curve or the number of ticks in a day.$(br2)$(info)Side effect$(): everything measured in "in-game hours" - minimum growth hours, rain relief and cauldron filling - speeds up or slows down along with it.
